rules: If the President of the United States has invoked the Insurrection Act to deploy the United States military and/or the federalized National Guard within the United States before Jan 20, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.

knowledge.text: KXINSURRECTION rule text: "If the President of the United States has invoked the Insurrection Act to deploy the United States military and/or the federalized National Guard within the United States before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes." The 2028 and Jan 20, 2029 strikes use the same wording.

On Jan. 15, 2026, Trump threatened to invoke the Insurrection Act over the Minneapolis protests against ICE operations. He backed off the next day, saying there was not a "reason right now," and added, "if I needed it, I'd use it."
KXTRUMPRESIGN rule text: "If the President of the United States elected for the 2025-2029 term resigns the office, then the market resolves to Yes." It closes Jan. 21, 2029.
KXGREENLAND-29 needs the United States to purchase at least part of Greenland from Denmark before Jan. 20, 2029. A security or basing agreement is not a purchase.

Asia Business Daily reported that Trump said on July 24, 2026: "I am going to run for a fourth term as President of the United States." The paper listed this as one of his repeated third-term references.

Trump appointed Louisiana Gov. Jeff Landry special envoy to Greenland in December 2025; Landry said he would work to make Greenland part of the United States.

KXPRESPERSON-28: "If [person] is the next person inaugurated as President for the term beginning in 2029, then the market resolves to Yes." Source: Office of the Presidency. Expected expiration 2029-01-21.
